context.body: The preserved household enters a new scene of exposure, response, speech, descendants, and power.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Noah plants a vineyard, becomes drunk, and lies uncovered; Ham sees and reports, while Shem and Japheth cover without looking.
observations.label: Noah’s vineyard exposes a household fracture: action

observations.body: After waking, Noah speaks a curse over Canaan and blessings concerning Shem and Japheth, then the account closes with his death.
observations.label: Noah’s vineyard exposes a household fracture: response

observations.body: vineyard · drunk · uncovered · saw · covered · Canaan is cursed
observations.label: Words in Genesis 9:18–29

payload.posture: Read Genesis 9:18–29 as blessing and household fracture evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The text does not explain why Canaan becomes the target of Noah’s curse after naming Ham’s act.
payload.title: Noah’s vineyard exposes a household fracture
